compiled:
📰 General

Clayface Dominates Box Office, Marking Skydance’s Second Consecutive No. 1 •

DC’s Clayface achieved a global box office opening of $43 million, securing its second consecutive weekend at the top of the charts. This success represents the first back-to-back No. 1 win for the newly formed Skydance, following the Paramount-Warner Bros. merger. The film’s performance indicates strong initial audience interest in the superhero property. Analysts are currently assessing whether this trend signals a new standard for blockbuster releases within the merged Skydance organization.

🌍 World

Zelensky Attributes Intensified Russian Attacks to Starlink Service Restoration •

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russia significantly increased its attack frequency over the past week, coinciding with SpaceX’s reinstatement of Starlink and Starshield satellite internet access. Prior to this restoration, internet service disruptions hampered Ukraine’s ability to communicate and coordinate defenses. The Kremlin has repeatedly blamed Ukraine’s reliance on Western satellite technology for its military operations. SpaceX’s service resumption appears to have provided Ukraine with a crucial communication lifeline amidst the ongoing conflict.

🦅 US

Steelers vs. Saints: TV Channel, Streaming Details for Sunday’s International Match •

The New Orleans Saints will face the Pittsburgh Steelers in an NFL Week 7 game scheduled for Sunday, October 25, 2026. The contest will take place at Stade de France in Saint-Denis, France, with a kickoff time of 9:30 AM EDT. Fans can watch the game on Fox television, or stream it through Fox Sports’ website and app. The Saints are aiming to capitalize on a recent victory as they host the Steelers in the 2026 regular season.

💰 Business

Top 10 Trucks & SUVs Named Most Dangerous Vehicles on U.S. Roads •

A recent analysis, utilizing Hines Law data, has identified the ten most dangerous vehicles on American roads based on driver fatality rates. Trucks and SUVs consistently topped the list, reflecting their larger size and impact potential in collisions. The study examined annual driver fatality rates across all vehicle types to determine the highest risk vehicles. These vehicles pose a significant threat to smaller vehicles and pedestrians due to their substantial mass and momentum.

💻 Technology

Nitro Deck 2 for Switch 2 Shows Promise, Yet Falls Short of Perfection •

The Crkd Nitro Deck 2, priced at $99.99, offers compatibility with both the original Nintendo Switch and the Switch 2. The accessory provides a protective case and improved button feel compared to the original Nitro Deck. However, reviewers note that it’s approximately three millimeters too large for optimal Switch 2 fit. Despite these minor issues, the accessory represents a step forward in Switch 2 controller customization options.

🎭 Entertainment

Sacha Baron Cohen Announces “Ali G: Who Iz I?” as Final Comedy Performance •

Sacha Baron Cohen has stated that “Ali G: Who Iz I?” will mark his final foray into over-the-top comedic roles. During an interview with The Hollywood Reporter, the 55-year-old actor explained that he believes these types of performances have become too risky. The film, a revival of his iconic character, features him as a fictional version of himself. Cohen indicated a desire to move away from the character’s provocative and satirical style.

🏅 Sports

Christian McCaffrey Exits 49ers Game with Thigh Injury – Latest Blow for SF •

Christian McCaffrey sustained a thigh injury and was removed from the San Francisco 49ers’ Week 7 game against the Atlanta Falcons. The injury occurred during the contest, marking another setback for the team dealing with multiple player ailments. Medical personnel attended to McCaffrey on the sidelines before he departed the game. The exact nature and severity of the injury remain unconfirmed at this time.

🔬 Science

NASA Botanist’s Orbital Experiments Reveal New Insights into Plant Growth in Space •

NASA astronaut Jessica Watkins is currently performing botany experiments on the International Space Station as part of the Crew-13 mission. The experiments focus on understanding how plants adapt to the unique conditions of microgravity and the effects of altered light cycles. Watkins is utilizing a specially designed growth chamber to study plant development, including root formation and overall biomass. Data collected will contribute to future long-duration space missions and potential closed-loop life support systems.

🩺 Health

E. coli Cases Linked to Bengtson’s Pumpkin Farm in Will County •

Five individuals have been confirmed with E. coli infections potentially linked to visits to Bengtson’s Pumpkin Farm near Homer Glen, Illinois. The Will County Health Department is currently investigating the source of the contamination. Initial investigations are focusing on potential foodborne illnesses associated with the farm’s activities. Authorities are urging visitors to the farm to seek medical attention if they experience symptoms such as severe stomach cramps, diarrhea, and vomiting. Further details regarding the investigation and potential closures are expected to be released.
